ExternalServiceRegistration.label: Vertex Fraud Agent
ExternalServiceRegistration.schema:
openapi: "3.0.3"
info: title: Meridian Fraud Risk Agent version: "0.1.0" description: > Scores MRI pre-authorization requests for fraud risk signals using Gemini 2.5 Pro. Designed for registration as a Salesforce External Service. Note: no authentication scheme is configured — this is a demo simplification. Add OAuth 2.0 / Named Credentials before production use.
servers: - url: https://fraud-agent-re72ei6qxa-uc.a.run.app description: Cloud Run deployment of the Meridian Fraud Risk Agent.
paths: /tasks: post: operationId: scoreFraudRisk summary: Score a pre-authorization request for fraud risk description: > Accepts an MRI pre-authorization request and returns a Gemini-generated fraud-risk score with classification and rationale. Outputs are for human-reviewer routing; they are not legal fraud determinations. requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/FraudScoreRequest" examples: low_risk_example: summary: Low-risk member (M-10047) value: member_id: "M-10047" cpt: "73721" provider_npi: "1234567890" indication: "knee pain 3 months, MRI knee ordered" member_context: risk_tier: "standard" prior_auth_reversals_12mo: 0 state: "TX" flags: [] high_risk_example: summary: High-risk member (M-10099) value: member_id: "M-10099" cpt: "73721" provider_npi: "9876543210" indication: "routine screening" member_context: risk_tier: "high" prior_auth_reversals_12mo: 6 state: "TX" flags: - "geo_mismatch" - "duplicate_claim_pattern" responses: "200": description: Fraud-risk score produced successfully. content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/FraudScoreResponse" "422": description: Validation error — request body did not match schema. content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/HTTPValidationError" "500": description: Internal error — Gemini API call failed or returned unparseable output. content: application/json: schema: $ref: "#/components/schemas/HTTPError"
components: schemas:
MemberContext: type: object required: - risk_tier - prior_auth_reversals_12mo - state - flags properties: risk_tier: type: string description: "Payer-assigned risk tier (e.g. 'standard', 'elevated', 'high')." example: "standard" prior_auth_reversals_12mo: type: integer minimum: 0 description: Number of prior-authorization reversals in the past 12 months. example: 0 state: type: string description: Two-letter US state code for the member's primary residence. example: "TX" flags: type: array items: type: string description: Explicit risk flags already recorded against this member. example: []
FraudScoreRequest: type: object required: - member_id - cpt - provider_npi - indication - member_context properties: member_id: type: string description: Unique member identifier. example: "M-10047" cpt: type: string description: CPT procedure code being requested. example: "73721" provider_npi: type: string description: 10-digit NPI of the ordering provider. example: "1234567890" indication: type: string description: Free-text clinical indication supplied by the ordering provider. example: "knee pain 3 months, MRI knee ordered" member_context: $ref: "#/components/schemas/MemberContext"
FraudScoreResponse: type: object required: - risk_score - classification - rationale - flags - model_version - decision_timestamp properties: risk_score: type: number format: float minimum: 0.0 maximum: 1.0 description: Continuous fraud-risk score between 0 (no risk) and 1 (highest risk). example: 0.08 classification: type: string enum: - low_risk - elevated - high_risk description: > Categorical classification: low_risk (<0.30), elevated (0.30–0.69), high_risk (>=0.70). example: "low_risk" rationale: type: string description: > Human-readable explanation citing the specific signals that drove the score. Required for audit and human-reviewer handoff. example: > No prior reversals in 12 months; indication matches CPT; provider in expected geography. flags: type: array items: type: string description: Short labels for signals that contributed to the score. example: [] model_version: type: string description: Gemini model identifier used to produce this score. example: "gemini-2.5-pro" decision_timestamp: type: string format: date-time description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the score was produced. example: "2026-04-15T20:00:00Z"
HTTPError: type: object properties: detail: type: string
ValidationError: type: object required: - loc - msg - type properties: loc: type: array items: type: string msg: type: string type: type: string
HTTPValidationError: type: object properties: detail: type: array items: $ref: "#/components/schemas/ValidationError"
